Drunk Auto Driver Booked While Ferrying Schoolchildren in Hyderabad

An auto-rickshaw driver was booked by police in Hyderabad's Goshamahal area for allegedly driving under the influence of alcohol. The driver was reportedly ferrying six schoolchildren at the time of the incident, which occurred during a special traffic enforcement drive.
